Record is a systematic review protocol (PROSPERO-registered) reporting no primary data.
Immunohistochemistry measured EZH2 and SUZ12 protein expression in megakaryocytes; regulator protein levels are not a directly measured methylation, histone modification or chromatin-state marker.
Birth cohort of 531 infants with cord-blood AHRR DNA methylation related to maternal obesity and smoke exposure, modifiable exposures.
Retrospective review of 15 diagnosed T-LBL cases is a case series without a comparison group, and chromatin is described only morphologically.
Individual-level DNA methylation, copy number and expression data from a Taiwanese lung adenocarcinoma cohort with external validation, related to survival prognosis.
Case-control comparison of HLA-G promoter methylation by bisulfite pyrosequencing in preeclamptic versus normal pregnancy placentas.
Dunedin cohort biological-age measures were facial age, blood-biomarker algorithms, Framingham heart age and telomere length, none of which is an epigenetic marker.
Age- and BMI-matched case-control study measuring genome-wide ovarian DNA methylation in PCOS versus controls with biomarker and diagnostic intent.
Case-control study of plasma BCAT1 and IKZF1 methylation in 74 colorectal cancer cases and 144 controls, developed as a screening blood test.
Triptolide and Minnelide were evaluated only in colon cancer cell lines and mouse xenograft and liver metastasis models, with no human participants or samples.
Descriptive histopathological report of 23 MIFS cases; a morphological case series is not one of the five eligible designs.
A SNP-based genetic risk score and CpG-oligonucleotide-stimulated interferon responses were measured; no DNA methylation, histone or chromatin marker was assayed.
Quantitative DNA methylation of the miR-34b/c locus measured in 57 soft-tissue sarcomas versus 20 normal controls and related to clinical stage and prognosis.
Genome-wide DNA methylation measured in 154 primary gastric cancers and 47 matched non-neoplastic mucosae, linked to drug response and diagnostic and prognostic marker use.
Infinium genome-wide DNA methylation in 109 non-cancerous and 105 tumorous gastric samples, with methylation clusters related to tumour aggressiveness and survival.
Cohort of 807 colorectal cancers in which CpG island methylator phenotype was measured as part of a Lynch syndrome screening strategy.
Case-control study measuring methylation at imprinted and other loci in chorionic villus and cord blood of IVM versus conventionally conceived neonates, an intervention exposure.
Case-control study measuring global DNA methylation in PBMCs of 37 late-onset Alzheimer cases and 44 controls, proposed as a screening marker.
Minimal residual disease was measured by flow cytometry to guide ARA-C dosing; no epigenetic marker was assayed.
Human liver disease samples were assessed for Gankyrin and phospho-IRAK-1 expression only; the ChIP and histone acetyltransferase work was done in cell lines.
DNA methylation at the GSDMB/ORMDL3 locus measured in birth-cohort and case-control samples and related to physician-diagnosed childhood asthma.
Cross-sectional analysis of 8,516 CLSA participants relating socioeconomic disadvantage to six measured DNA methylation age clocks.
BASE-II and GendAge cohort with measured epigenetic clocks related cross-sectionally and longitudinally to type 2 diabetes complications and risk scoring.
Prospective cohort of 2,594 heart failure patients with whole-blood DNA methylation scores and clocks assessed for prognostic value beyond clinical risk factors.
Nested case-control study within the Shanghai Women's Health Study relating measured DNA methylation inflammation risk scores to lung cancer risk.
Prospective cohort of hrHPV-positive women in which EPB41L3 and HPV DNA methylation was evaluated as a triage test for CIN2+, a screening decision.

Ageing-clock model benchmark uses individual-level human cohort data including blood DNA methylation and evaluates age acceleration against mortality, so tool development in a human sample, though the participant-level design is only loosely described.
Biological age was estimated from LC-MS metabolomics only, with no epigenetic marker measured.
Plasma cfDNA 5mC and 5hmC methylomes measured longitudinally in metastatic prostate cancer patients enrolled in a phase 2 trial and related to treatment response and resistance.
Record is a protocol for a planned case-control study; samples and analyses are described in the future tense with no results.
Case-control comparison of CDH1 promoter and enhancer CpG methylation in ileal mucosa of 21 Crohn disease patients versus 16 non-IBD surgical controls.
RADAR is a computational discovery pipeline over GTEx and TCGA resources with no human evaluation sample forming one of the five eligible designs.

Epigenetic clock data from large cohorts and a caloric restriction trial are described but no results are reported, so it cannot be told whether this is a conference abstract without data or a reported primary analysis.
Generation Scotland cohort of 5,828 participants with measured APOE DNA methylation evaluated for predicting Alzheimer and cardiovascular disease risk.
Cross-sectional study measured dental age and salivary alkaline phosphatase; no epigenetic marker was assayed.
Multicentre series of 25 paediatric medulloblastomas in which measured DNA methylation classification was compared with immunohistochemical subgrouping for diagnosis and treatment stratification.
Multi-institutional cohort of 94 childhood CNS tumours with genome-wide DNA methylation profiling evaluated against histological diagnosis for diagnostic reclassification.
Tissue and liquid NGS measured gene mutations, including mutations in chromatin remodelling genes, but no epigenetic mark was directly measured.
SCT promoter methylation measured in human primary tumours from the TCGA lung cohort and in cancer-free human tissues as a diagnostic cancer biomarker, despite substantial cell-line discovery work.
H2BK120 deubiquitination and H3K27 trimethylation were assayed in melanoma cell lines; patient samples contributed only USP7 and EZH2 expression correlated with grade and prognosis.
Systematic biopsy profiling of the first 100 patients in the BIOMEDE randomised trial, with loss of H3-K27 trimethylation measured in human tumour samples informing biomarker-guided therapy.
